verses.1: When Jehovah brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.
verses.2: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing: Then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.
verses.3: Jehovah hath done great things for us, Whereof we are glad.
verses.4: Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah, As the streams in the South.
verses.5: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.6: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves with him.
